sprint_note: Adds backend/routers/experiment.py (new), extends backend/scheduling.py with ClassicScheduler/FSRSScheduler/decide_scheduler_assignment, extends backend/routers/flashcards.py (due-row scheduler field, rewritten review dispatch + fsrs_card_state/review_events writes, upsert assignment), extends backend/ingest.py and backend/exploration.py (assignment at their existing was_inserted/create_card gates), extends schema.sql (fsrs_card_state, review_events, flashcard_review_state additive columns, guarded migration backfill), adds fsrs>=6.3.2 to pyproject.toml, and extends src/ShellEntry.tsx + shellConfig.ts with a scheduler badge and a new experiment dashboard view/route.

files.role: Pure spaced-repetition scheduling seam. compute_next_due_at and VALID_GRADES are UNCHANGED this sprint. Adds the Classic/FSRS dispatch wrappers, the SchedulerResult shape, the scheduler-assignment decision helper, and the FSRS-config module constants.

public_objects.purpose: Unchanged.

public_objects.name: SchedulerResult
public_objects.purpose: typing.NamedTuple(next_due_at: datetime, review_interval: timedelta, extra_state: dict | None). Common return shape for both scheduler adapters.

methods.name: review
methods.purpose: Thin pass-through to compute_next_due_at; extra_state always None. existing_state is accepted but ignored (Classic persists no state beyond the existing three columns).

methods.name: review
methods.purpose: Loads or creates an fsrs.Card (Card.from_dict(existing_state['raw_state']) if existing_state else Card()), converts now to exactly timezone.utc, calls the module-level fsrs.Scheduler.review_card, and returns next_due_at/review_interval plus extra_state (stability, difficulty, fsrs_state, step, last_review_at, raw_state).

methods.name: decide_scheduler_assignment
methods.purpose: Reads ESSAYCARDS_FSRS_EXPERIMENT_ENABLED fresh from os.environ (default true) each call. If disabled: ('classic', 'assignment_disabled_classic'). Else: a stable hash-of-flashcard_id split into ('classic'|'fsrs', 'new_card_random'|'migrated_never_reviewed_random'). Asserts the chosen reason is in _SCHEDULER_ASSIGNMENT_REASONS before returning.

public_objects.name: EXPERIMENT_VERSION
public_objects.purpose: 'sprint10_v1' — written into flashcard_review_state.experiment_version at every assignment (new-card and migration).

private_objects.name: _FSRS_SCHEDULER
private_objects.purpose: Module-level fsrs.Scheduler(desired_retention=0.9), library-default parameters/learning_steps/relearning_steps. Constructed once at import time and reused (fsrs.Scheduler carries no per-card state).

private_objects.name: _SCHEDULER_ASSIGNMENT_REASONS
private_objects.purpose: The closed 4-value vocabulary ('new_card_random', 'migrated_never_reviewed_random', 'legacy_retained_classic', 'assignment_disabled_classic'); the CHECK constraint in schema.sql is the actual enforcement point. Must be wired into decide_scheduler_assignment's return value as a defensive assertion (assert reason in _SCHEDULER_ASSIGNMENT_REASONS before returning) so it is an active guard, not dead code.

private_objects.name: _experiment_enabled
private_objects.purpose: os.environ.get('ESSAYCARDS_FSRS_EXPERIMENT_ENABLED', 'true') truthiness check, read fresh every call.

private_objects.name: EXPERIMENT_SUMMARY_SCHEMA
private_objects.purpose: ColumnSchema list: scheduler, assigned_cards, new_cards_assigned, migrated_cards_assigned, cards_new, cards_learning, cards_established, reviewed_cards, completed_reviews, ordinary_due_reviews, recall_rate, failures. No FSRS-native vocabulary in any label.

private_objects.name: _assignment_counts_by_scheduler
private_objects.purpose: GROUP BY scheduler over essaycards.flashcard_review_state -> dict[scheduler, {assigned_cards, new_cards_assigned, migrated_cards_assigned, cards_new, cards_learning, cards_established}].

private_objects.name: _review_counts_by_scheduler
private_objects.purpose: GROUP BY scheduler over essaycards.review_events -> dict[scheduler, {reviewed_cards, completed_reviews, ordinary_due_reviews, failures}]. ordinary_due_reviews/failures are filtered on prior_review_interval >= interval '24 hours' (NOT was_due, which is true for virtually every reachable review and stored only as an audit field) — mirrors the app's existing learning/established threshold and excludes rapid-retry/immediate-relearning reviews per 11_design_review.md's Minimal Change Set.
